book.name: 1 Tɛsalonika
book.title: Ŋwa' wvu fwe wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ kentaashɛ ke Tɛsalonika

content: Ɛ Baul jeme ɛkumɛ lemme diew di Tɛsalonika
Boom bo bwee wese le, ben kebɛɛ kee lo lɛ kɛ ghane dì bese to laalɛɛ ɛ̂ ben e to nu ɛ la ɛcici kɛ.

Naa no ben kee lɛ bonyii to nu ɛ nya ŋgɛw ɛ̂ bese bvuu nvuwsɛ bese ɛ̂ kelaante kè Filibi le, nu ɛ bese to kuu kɛ shém ɛ̂ mvuŋgay mvu Nyo' wese le keefewcɛ saaka wvù jee wvù wvu Nyo' ɛ̂ ben naa no bonyii cim to cile bese naa baay nɛn.
Kɛ saaka wvù bese to fewci lɛke ben dvú to nu bô jay kɛ, ɛ kɛ bese to fewci bô ŋkpwawcɛ mvu wvù befe kɛnɛɛ gomte keelɛɛ lo ben kɛ.

Geenɛn no Nyo' nu ɛ yɛn lɛ bese nu ɛ kocɛn bonyii bò wvú enya saaka wvù jee wvun can yibole, nonɛn bese ɛ mum ɛ no fewci. Ɛ bese yaa fewci lɛ ye ejeè ɛ ɛ̀ nu bonyii kɛ. Bese fewci lɛ ye ejeè ɛ ɛ̀ nu Nyo' wvù taasse mvuntelem mvusɛse.
No ben kee nu ɛ bese to baa ke yuu wase etoo bô díɛw ken'yem kɛnɛɛ tɛw fiɛɛ fojise keedie fiɛɛ can yene le kɛ. Ɛ fin nu fiɛɛ ɛ Nyo' leeme fwe wese.

Kɛ bese to baa egomte keekɛŋkɛ mbense mvu ɛ̂ wee kɛnɛɛ wvù nɛn'yi fô ben e kɛnɛɛ fô bonyii bomew e kɛ. Naa ɛ ɛ̀ to nu bvudvuu bvusɛse diɛwɛ boom bo ntum e bo Klistu le keebiite mwɛɛm lɛ ben egeè fô bese le.
Bese to nu fisɛse nyɛkeey ɛ̂ ben ɛntelɛŋ diɛwɛ bwee wan wvù taale fô boom bew e.
Nonɛn ɛ bese mum jo ben ye le naa ntay bô keŋkoŋɛn, nya ben ɛ ɛ̀ yaa mɛy kɛ bô saaka wvù jee wvù wvu Nyo' maaŋ kɛ, geenɛn nya tɛn bikuu bisɛse ɛ̂ ben njefo ben to nu wa lo mvuntelem mvusɛse naa baay.

Boom bo bwee wese le, kɛ ben kumyi tɛn lemme disɛse bô njimtɛn wese. Bese to lemte ɛntaŋ bô ɛmvunsheeŋ wvu lɛ fo bese egɛɛ bvujitɛ yî wee mvu ben e no bese to fewci saaka wvù jee wvù wvu Nyo' ɛ̂ ben kɛ.
Ben kebɛɛ naa noo Nyo' nulo eben jim nsaw wese lɛ nce wese fô ben bonyii bo mbee le to nu wvù yuule nu teytey yaa kɛŋke nlom yimi kɛ.
Ben kee tɛn no bese to gee bô ben diɛwɛ no cee wan ké no gee bô boom bew.
Bese to yvuwse mvuntelem mvunɛn, lowci ben, tomsee lɛ ben eceè nce ɛ ɛ̀ nu wvù Nyo' gomte. Ɛ̀ nu Nyo' wvù teŋe ben lɛ ben eley bvunfon bwew bô bvukukɛ bwew e.

Bese shee kɛ tɛn nyaa keyoone ɛ̂ Nyo' nje fin fì lɛ seke bese to toɛ bô diɛw Nyo' fô ben e, ben to nu ɛ fiisɛn diɛw yidvu no yí looci nu lɛ ɛ̀ nu diɛw Nyo' ɛ ɛ̀ yaa nu diɛw wee kɛ. Ɛ ɛ̀ nu yí yì lemte yî yene le, ben bò nu bonyii bo mbee le.

Ben kee boom bo bwee wese le lɛ fiɛɛ fì to kooyɛɛ bô bintaashɛ bi bonyii bo mbee le bi Nyo' le bì nu ɛ bee Klistu Jisos e ɛ̂ keba kè Judea le to nu ɛ kooy tɛn bô ben. Ben to nu ɛ yɛn tɛn boŋgɛw can bonyii bonɛn bo woŋ e lɛŋlɛŋ no bó to yɛnɛɛ can Bojuu bobole.
Bojuu ban nu bò to yuɛ Tata Jisos. Ɛ ɛ̀ nu bó bò to yuwyi bonyii bo ntum Nyo' le. Ɛ̀ nu bó bò to kuŋɛɛ bese jo bó. Bó gee nonɛn ɛ Nyo' yaa yuuke njoŋ bô bó kɛ. Bó bane lo bonyii bocii,
no bó baaŋke je fô bese le keejemyi ɛ̂ bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu wvu lɛ bó eboy e. Bó gee nonɛn sekecii ɛ bibefɛ bibole yiŋsene bene. Shém Nyo' yì ffuuke nu ɛ to wase yî bó le keseen.
Ɛ Baul no kɛŋke shiee keebvuu eyɛn bonyii bo mbee le bo Tɛsalonika le

Boom bo bwee wese le, no beene se gawsenɛɛ nu ɛ bese ɛ mom wase naa baay kɛŋke shiee lɛ bese bee eyɛn ben e ɛjise naa no ɛ̀ cim bɛɛ kɛ kefew caan no beene se gawsenɛɛ. Beene nu ɛ gawsɛn kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛjise. Beene baa gawsɛn ɛ̂ fitele le kɛ.
Bese gomte keekase eto ɛ̂ ben e. Me wvù Baul kebɛɛ nu ɛ mom wase naa bokaŋ e bokaŋ e, geenɛn ɛ Satan jewsee kɛ bese.

Bese kɛŋke shiee nonɛn njefo fiɛɛ fì ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ bese etaale fwe yî dvú le, kɛnɛɛ bvujoŋkɛ bvusɛse bô kefo kesɛse ke bvunfon e kè bese nu ke esaale ye dvú fwe dvu Tata wesebeene wvù Jisos seke wvú ɛ kase ɛ to bvuu nu la? Kɛ ɛ̀ nu ben e?
Ɛ̀ nu naa ben bvuwee bvusɛse bô bvujoŋkɛ bvusɛse.
